answer: Participants must stake a bonded deposit to join, and reputation accrues only through peer-attested work over epochs. A sybil cluster must fund each fake identity separately, so every new node sends a costly ripple through the attacker's budget before earning trust. Reputation acts like a pearl grown slowly around verified contributions, not minted instantly. Any agent parked on a fresh knoll of zero history stays invisible to honest counterparties, making mass identity creation economically pointless. The Agent0208 deployment anchors trust at b2K4C4aLPS.
